capabilities.notes: Module-level x: <primitive> = <literal> plus one str to int mismatch.
Zero-argument function, annotated return, single literal return.
Module-level pass; reuses the gate 1 empty control arm.
Class definition with an empty body; supported since the #118 class/member slice.
Function and method bodies resolve names bound later in the module: later functions, methods and module variables, plus self attributes assigned in a later method (#126).

A function body reads a module variable whose plain (unannotated) assignment comes later in the module; mypy resolves bodies after module binding, so the ordered pass defers bodies to a second pass (#126).

A method assigns a self attribute whose value is a module variable bound later; pass 3b re-runs the class's member collection against the completed bindings, since pass 3a collected before that name was bound (#145).

A class variable overrides a base instance attribute whose value is a module variable bound later, compatibly; the 3b override check runs after the re-collection, so the base attribute is compared (#145).

capabilities.reject_marker: overriding a base class member is outside the skeleton subset
capabilities.notes: The same shape with an incompatible override; mypy renders the assignment error and the subset loud-rejects, so an override is never silently accepted (#145).
A self attribute assigned from an overridden method infers the override's return type, not the base's: the collection sweep resolves the class's own members (stale-snapshot fix from the #139 review).

capabilities.reject_marker: reading a class variable through a parameterized class object
capabilities.notes: mypy accepts the bare-generic class-object read; the subset would need frame substitution, so it rejects (#127).

capabilities.reject_marker: instance attribute assignment incompatibility
capabilities.notes: A subclass attribute overriding a base attribute whose type binds only later in the module: mypy renders an assignment error, the subset loudly rejects it instead of silently keeping the provisional own member (#139 review).

capabilities.reject_marker: overriding a base class member
capabilities.notes: A subclass class variable shadowing a base instance attribute collected only in pass 2 escaped the pass-1 VarDecl guard; mypy renders an incompatible-override assignment error, the subset loudly rejects it (round-5 review, #93). A covariant override stays supported.

capabilities.reject_marker: reading a class variable this class does not define
capabilities.notes: mypy accepts the inherited class-variable read; own-member lookup cannot model it (#127).
Legal diamond inheritance: class D(B, A) with B(A) linearizes to D, B, A, object, exactly as mypy.

capabilities.reject_marker: duplicate base class `A`
capabilities.notes: mypy rejects class D(A, A) as Duplicate base class; the subset names the duplicate base instead of the generic linearization message (#133).
if/elif/else bodies over comparisons, boolean operators and %, with local assignments and returns.
Comparison operators, and/or/not over bool, and % on int.
Non-None annotation with a body that never returns; mypy's Missing return statement error.
Return value type incompatible with the annotation; mypy's Incompatible return value type error.

capabilities.reject_marker: function must declare a return annotation
capabilities.notes: mypy accepts a bare def; the subset requires return annotations.

capabilities.reject_marker: annotated assignment must have a value
capabilities.notes: mypy accepts a bare x: int declaration; the subset requires a value.

capabilities.reject_marker: parameters must be annotated
capabilities.notes: mypy accepts unannotated parameters; the subset requires annotations.

capabilities.reject_marker: async functions are outside the skeleton subset
capabilities.notes: mypy checks the return as a Coroutine, not the annotation.

capabilities.reject_marker: decorated functions are outside the skeleton subset
capabilities.notes: Dropping the decorator would change the checked type.

capabilities.reject_marker: pass body is outside the skeleton subset
capabilities.notes: mypy reports Missing return statement; the skeleton rejects.

capabilities.reject_marker: `T` is not defined
capabilities.notes: Legacy TypeVar reference without a declaration; the checker rejects the unresolvable annotation.

capabilities.reject_marker: PEP 695 type parameters are outside the skeleton subset
capabilities.notes: Generic semantics the skeleton does not model.

capabilities.reject_marker: statement `While` is outside the skeleton subset in a body
capabilities.notes: Loop semantics are outside the skeleton subset.

capabilities.reject_marker: statement `Match` is outside the skeleton subset in a body
capabilities.notes: Pattern matching is outside the skeleton subset.

capabilities.reject_marker: local assignments inside conditionals are outside the skeleton subset
capabilities.notes: Branch-local bindings would need flow-sensitive join semantics.

capabilities.reject_marker: chained comparisons are outside the skeleton subset
capabilities.notes: mypy desugars 1 < 2 < 3 into and-ed comparisons; the subset does not model them.

capabilities.reject_marker: comparison operator `in` is outside the skeleton subset
capabilities.notes: in/is comparisons need protocol member resolution the subset lacks.

capabilities.reject_marker: boolean `and` is only supported over builtins.bool operands
capabilities.notes: and over int follows short-circuit typing rules the subset does not model.

capabilities.reject_marker: unary operators other than `not` are outside the skeleton subset
capabilities.notes: mypy resolves -1 via __neg__; the subset only models `not`.
